water_evidence: No global white, blue or dark exclusion: South legend contains pale and black geological units. Thin river linework and shoreline classification remain approximate. Any source-water mask is limited to documented native lake interiors.
credit: Всесоюзное аэрогеологическое научно-производственное объединение «Аэрогеология», Министерство геологии СССР, Москва 1979. Native source notices retained.
source_rights: Source rights remain with authors/rightsholders; no open redistribution license established. Native scans, excerpts and source-derived vectors are excluded from any repository software license. Hosting on Geokniga is not proof of an open license.
method: Actual legend-swatch Lab segmentation, not SAM. Text/hatch filtering and majority smoothing; no removed-small-region holes or nearest-neighbor geological infill. Corrected Kazakhstan border including Baikonur is unchanged.
